The source document contains multiple continuous numbered lists that span across pages (e.g., 'People with Lived Experience' spans from page 2 to page 3; item 9 is on page 2, and item 10 is on page 3). In the output JSON, whenever a list crosses a page boundary, a new 'list' element is created with 'list_type': 'ordered' but without any start index. This will cause the numbering to incorrectly reset to 1 in the final output (e.g., item '10)' will be rendered as '1)').
